_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What this tool does and the licensing round trip, step by step.
ToolTips.This Machine: License the PC this app runs on: save a request, then apply the license that comes back.
ToolTips.Fleet: Collect requests from, and apply licenses to, many machines over the network.
ToolTips.Environment > Radmin: This environment's Radmin license key, transfer folder and rserver3 command settings.
ToolTips.This Machine > Refresh: Check again whether Radmin Server is installed here and whether it is licensed.
ToolTips.This Machine > Restart as administrator: Start this app again as administrator (needed to save a request or apply a license), then close this copy.
ToolTips.This Machine > Change: Pick the transfer folder on this PC (e.g. the USB stick). Remembered on this PC only.
ToolTips.This Machine > Open: Open the transfer folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.This Machine > Save request: Run rserver3.exe /saverequest with this environment's license key and copy <MACHINE>.request to <Transfer>\Requests.
ToolTips.This Machine > Apply license: Find <MACHINE>.license in <Transfer>\Licenses, apply it with rserver3.exe /uselicense and check the licensed registry key.
ToolTips.This Machine > Browse for a license file: Pick a .license file anywhere and apply it to this machine.
ToolTips.Fleet > Add machines: Type or paste machine names to add to the list.
ToolTips.Fleet > Import list: Add machine names from a text or CSV file (a Name / ComputerName column works).
ToolTips.Fleet > Remove selected: Take the selected machines off this list. Nothing is changed on the machines.
ToolTips.Fleet > Check status: Ask each machine whether Radmin Server is installed and licensed. Changes nothing.
ToolTips.Fleet > 1. Collect requests: Make <MACHINE>.request on every unlicensed machine and bring it back into <Transfer>\Requests.
ToolTips.Fleet > 3. Apply licenses: Push each <MACHINE>.license from <Transfer>\Licenses to its machine, apply it and check the registry key.
ToolTips.Fleet > Stop: Stop the run: machines in progress are stopped, the rest are skipped. Results so far are kept.
ToolTips.Fleet > Open transfer folder: Open the transfer folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.Fleet > Change: Pick the transfer folder on this PC (e.g. the USB stick). Remembered on this PC only.
ToolTips.Fleet > Rescan folder: Look in the transfer folder again for request and license files.
ToolTips.Fleet > Only the selected machines: On: the buttons act on the selected rows only. Off: on every machine in the list.
ToolTips.Fleet > Also machines that are already l: On: collect a request / apply a license even where the machine is already licensed.
ToolTips.Add machines > Add: Add the names typed above to the list.
ToolTips.Environment > Radmin > Show: Show or hide the license key.
ToolTips.Environment > Radmin > Reset command set: Put the device folder, rserver3 path, registry key, arguments, timeout and connection back to the defaults (Save to keep).
